panels.title: Big questions
points: How can 1/4, 0.25 and 25% be the same number?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Zakah (زَكَاة) on savings held for a lunar year above the nisab is 2.5%, which is 1/40 or 0.025 of the amount. Converting between fractions, decimals and percentages helps a Muslim work out what is due accurately.
